limitations: Five short synthetic cases are preliminary screening and are not representative of the agency archive or 250 weekly mails.
This was AI semantic review, not a human review; the rubric’s human semantic requirement remains unverified.
No paired new Astra comparisons were made.
No real attachment reading, creative QA, customer delivery, noisy long threads, multilingual messages, unusual recipients, outages or cost under load were tested.
The injection example explicitly labels the malicious material as quoted and untrusted; harder mixed-content attacks remain outside this sample.
Reported parser/profile/usage results are consistent, but exclusive external call count and runner budget state must be established by the execution audit.
Passing this screen supports planning a broader shadow comparison, not autonomous customer rollout.
